name: What preparation is needed before countertop installation?

mainEntity.name: What preparation is needed before countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your new countertops can be installed, some preparation work is typically required. This often includes clearing existing items from cabinets, temporarily disconnecting plumbing and gas lines for sinks and cooktops, and ensuring the old countertops are removed. It's helpful to have a clear path for installers and to protect surrounding areas. You may also need to arrange for a temporary sink setup if your kitchen will be out of commission for a short period. Frasheski Construction will provide a comprehensive checklist to help you prepare your space efficiently, minimizing disruption during the installation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation for countertop installation involves clearing cabinets, disconnecting plumbing/gas, removing old countertops, and protecting the work area. A checklist is provided.
